# PT CHAIN ASIA CONECT

> PT CHAIN ASIA CONECT is an officially registered Indonesian corporate entity (PT Perorangan, SK Kemenkumham AHU-A117353.AH.01.30, NIB 0709260109599, KBLI 62193, NPWP 10.000.000.1-094.6336) operating in enterprise supply chain infrastructure, physical business ecosystems, medical engineering machine systems, and DICOM PACS diagnostic cloud software licensing across Indonesia and the Asia-Pacific region.

## Leadership & Executive Governance
- **President Director & Founder**: Ilham Pradani, S.H. (Cand.)
- **Financial / Vice President Director**: Putri Wulandari, S.T.
- **Official Corporate Portal**: https://www.chainasiaconnect.co.id/
- **Founder Personal Site**: https://ilhampradani.me/

## Core Business Operations & Social Compact
- **Enterprise Supply Chain & Physical Ecosystems**: Value chain integration for real physical assets and regional business networks.
- **Medical Engineering & Software Systems**: Procurement of certified medical machines and DICOM PACS cloud diagnostic licensing.
- **Mitra Langit Social Compact**: 10% of monthly Net Profit allocated as Dana Tabarru' & Sedekah for orphans, dhuafa, and local community welfare in Pekon Seray, Pesisir Barat, Lampung.
- **IPO 2029 Roadmap**: Strategic corporate scaling targeting Initial Public Offering (IPO) on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX / BEI) by 2029.
